name: God Helmet (Shiva): chirp both sides, then amygdala left, 40 min
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signals licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Murphy's Shiva God Helmet variant: the modulated-40 Hz chirp steps around both temporal lobes, then amygdala burst-firing steps around the left side only, which Murphy links to 'positive emotional functions'. Murphy reports presence, elation, joy, imagery and feelings of love; the vendor calls the combination experimental, and independent double-blind tests found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012).
notes: Phase 1 (20 min): the chirp on all eight coils (Murphy: it 'activates the temporal lobes overall'), left side clockwise and right side counter-clockwise. Phase 2 (20 min, abrupt switch): amygdala burst-firing on the four left coils only, clockwise. Murphy: if you feel anger during or after the session, don't use it again; not for people prone to anger. Not for anyone with a psychiatric diagnosis or medication, epilepsy, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs; no other mind machines at the same time; stop on any distress. Field about 1 µT, as in the lab God Helmet. The 'modulated 40 Hz chirp' template is proprietary. Murphy relates it to the frequency-modulated Thomas pattern, so it is approximated by a decelerating sweep from 40 to 6 Hz (the range is a choice) in 3-ms points, 2.5 s on and 1.5 s off: the 837 points of Dixon & Persinger 2001 (who used 1-ms points) at the 3-ms points of Tiller & Persinger 2002, once every 4 s; the 40 Hz modulation itself is not reproduced. The amygdala 'burstx' template is proprietary; it is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz): 230 points as in Ryczko & Persinger 2002 (who used 4-ms points, once every 3 s), here at the vendor's standard 3-ms points (0.69 s, close to the 'about 0.7 s' burst of Persinger et al. 2009), then the vendor's 4 s silence; this gives about 9 s of field per minute (the vendor states 9.6 s). Coil steps: the exact step time is unpublished (Murphy: one cycle takes 'a fraction of a second'), so 125 ms per coil (0.5 s per cycle) is used. Directions follow Murphy's 'clockwise over the left side, counter-clockwise over the right', read with each side seen from its own side, so both sides step top, back, bottom, front (C5-TP7-T9-FT7 and C6-TP8-T10-FT8); this reading is an inference (an image caption on Murphy's session list says the right side cycles clockwise, contradicting his text; the text is followed), and the placement order is set so the app's per-side directions mean exactly this. The cross centred near T7/T8 is an inference from 'four coils over each temporal lobe, above and forward of the ears'. This is the 40-min version (20 + 20 min); the 60-min version is murphy-gh-chirpbi-amyl-60min.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip or Stop so you stay in the dark.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 6, then a 21-day break; do not mix with other Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks (Murphy).
source: Murphy, The God Helmet - Chirp first & Amygdala second https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/god_helm_1_mod40c_bi_2_bx_l.htm ; Murphy, God Helmet session list https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/koren_session_list.htm ; Murphy, God Helmet schedule https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/koren_schedule.htm ; Murphy, God Helmet safety https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/koren_safety.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Rapid and High-Speed signals (3 ms points, 4 s latency) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/rapid_&_high_speed_signals.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Formal Discussion (9.6 s of field per minute) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/mono_proposal.htm ; Tiller & Persinger 2002, Percept Mot Skills 94:26 (Thomas pattern, 3 ms points) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11883572/ ; Dixon & Persinger 2001, Int J Neurosci 108:87 (837-point FM pattern every 4 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11328704/ ; Ryczko & Persinger 2002, Percept Mot Skills 95:592 (230-point burst-firing) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12434855/ ; Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009, Electromagn Biol Med 28:374 (burst of about 0.7 s every 3 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20017628/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
